forum.title: X-NUCLEO-SRC1M1 STEP or DXF File
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @FBL

Thanks, but not really useful for PCB design. I did my STEP file in less than two hours using the Gerber files from X-NUCLEO-SRC1M1 to get the board profile and a datum point for the connectors and then used the PCB from the NUCLEO-G491 STEP file as a template for the ST Morpho and Arduino connector locations. Connectors are downloads from the Samtec and Wurth websites based on the BOM information. It's the key information anyone needs for doing their own expansion board. If there are no objections from ST, I'll post my STEP file here for everyone's benefit once I've verified it mechanically.

Kind regards,

Al
forum.content_text:
Hi,

I want to create a pin-compatible board to X-NUCLEO-SRC1M1 to further explore USB-C charging, is there a STEP or DXF file available for this or any other X-NUCLEO board that has both the ST Morpho and Arduino UNO R3 connectors please?

Kind regards,

Al
forum.author: alw

scraped_replies.html:
This comes up quite frequently; eg, see: X-NUCLEO-IHM08M1 3D model.

Tl;DR: ST do not generally provide 3D models for evaluation boards.
scraped_replies.author: Andrew Neil

scraped_replies.html:
Hi @Andrew Neil 

I have downloaded quite a few STEP files for Discovery and NUCLEO boards from the ST website, and indeed some X-NUCLEO ones are also available with just the Arduino headers, a quick search will provide.

https://www.st.com/en/evaluation-tools/stm32-nucleo-expansion-boards.html#cad-resources

 

MB2160-WB05N-B01.step

Kind regards,

Al
scraped_replies.author: alw

scraped_replies.html:
I said they're not generally provided - but, indeed, some do exist.

As noted in the linked thread: if they are available, they will be on the 'CAD Resources' tab of the Product Page; if they aren't there, then they aren't available.

As also noted in that thread, some 3rd parties have published models.
scraped_replies.author: Andrew Neil

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @alw 

An internal ticket has been submitted to the dedicated team to review whether these requests are feasible. For internal tracking: CDM0062512.
